name: Lattice Sovereign
prompt: Elyndra final boss Lattice Sovereign, single complete front character master, hand-painted stylized fantasy MMORPG illustration with rich painted crystal and luminous violet light. Bible: A vast crowned lattice of violet light suspended over the chamber floor, a dark crystalline core inside, sentinel-like arms unfolding from the grid. Design a levitating three dimensional diamond-shaped cage of violet luminous interwoven grid bars, transparent gaps reveal dark obsidian faceted core within. A regal five-point angular violet crown at top. Two articulated sentinel-like dark plated arms emerge from left and right grid sides, elbows slightly bent, open five-finger hands. NO legs, no humanoid head, no throne, no chamber: body itself is the floating crowned lattice, not a knight wearing armor. Front orthographic eye-level neutral pose with symmetrical structure. Complete crown, both hands, lowest grid point and all glow fully visible, fit entire figure into central 70 percent of square canvas with wide empty margins. True transparent background, no ground, shadow, words, labels or watermark.
